item.tib: dam can rgya mtsho'i drag po'i las bcol
item.coloph: de ltar dbyings nas thugs dam rgyud bskul/ mkha' la rang bzhin mnga' gsol/ klong du drag po'i las bcol ba 'di ni/ gyer spungs dran pa nam mkha'i lung don/ spral sku blo ldanasnying po'i snyan rgyud/ dam can gnad du bkol ba'i bkol byang*/ byad ma'i gtor sna bzlog (zlog) pa'i don du/ bdag 'dra she tsu khi khar zhes bya bas gtan la phab pa'i/ byin rlabs nus pa shin tu myur ba'o//
